newsitem.title: INDIA: Brisk demand at Calcutta tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Brisk demand at Calcutta tea auction.

text.p: There was brisk demand at this week's Calcutta tea auction, traders said on Friday.
In all 81,274 packages, including 4,648 packages of Darjeeling tea, were on offer.
In CTC varieties, good Assam fannings were lower by two rupees while medium Assams tended two to three rupees lower.
Among Orthodox teas, fannings were two to three rupees easier.
Dust grades saw clean and liquoring varieties around last levels, while the remainder eased by one to two rupees.
